changelog: Fix: Risk Calculator's "Balance (today, auto)", Available Margin, the trade-limits status strip, the "+ New Trade"/"+ Trade" gate, and the risk-ladder tier lookup all ignored challenges.funding_adjustment — every one of them reads balanceAtDayStart() (helpers.php), which duplicated the balance formula without a funding term at all. balanceAtDayStart() now delegates to the new challengeBalance(), the same funding-aware formula enrichChallenge() already used, so all of these move in lockstep with the sidebar balance going forward.

Fix: the Bitfunded importer double-counted funding on any matched/new trade whose position also appeared in the pasted Transaction History — BitfundedImportController::confirm() subtracted that trade's own attributed funding inside trades.net_pnl AND rolled the same funding into challenges.funding_adjustment (the whole paste's Funding Fee total, of which that trade's own funding is already a subset), which enrichChallenge()'s current_balance then subtracted a second time. trades.net_pnl is now always pnl - fees, full stop; trades.funding is kept but is display-only and feeds no balance or P&L sum anywhere in the app.

Change: single balance source of truth — helpers.php::challengeBalance() is now the only place `starting_balance + SUM(net_pnl of closed trades[, before a given date]) - funding_adjustment` is computed. enrichChallenge() (current_balance) and balanceAtDayStart() (ladder/calculator balance) both call it instead of each keeping its own copy of the formula.

Add: Statistics -> P&L & Fees gains two rows, "Funding" and "Net After Funding" (get_stats: new funding_adjustment / net_pnl_after_funding fields), so the account's funding cost is visible as its own line instead of only implicitly inside Net P&L or the Exit Reason table's footnote.

Migration (manual — see note below): migrations/2026_09_24_0001_fix_double_counted_funding_in_net_pnl.sql repairs trades.net_pnl on rows written under the old double-counting formula (recomputes net_pnl = pnl - fees wherever it currently disagrees with that by more than a cent). Back up the trades table first; run the preview SELECT and eyeball the rows before applying the UPDATE. Does not touch challenges.funding_adjustment — that column was never the broken side of this bug and its current value is already correct. This file is deliberately NOT in this release's files/db_migrations below — see the note at the top of this changelog block.
release_notes: IMPORTANT — manual DB step, run by hand, not via this updater or migrate.php: after deploying this release, back up the `trades` table, then run migrations/2026_09_24_0001_fix_double_counted_funding_in_net_pnl.sql (preview SELECT first, then the UPDATE) against theittav_journal via phpMyAdmin or the mysql CLI. This file is intentionally excluded from the files list below and from db_migrations, so neither "Update Now" nor migrate.php?mode=run will ever touch it automatically — it lives in the repo's migrations/ folder for reference only in this release; do not copy it into the live server's migrations/ directory, or migrate.php's own directory scan would pick it up as a normal pending migration and could auto-apply it the next time mode=run is used for something unrelated.
